verdict.rationale: Bento has a dedicated DNS onboarding doc stating domain authentication records must be added to enable reliable sending on the sender's behalf, indicating guided DNS setup for domain authentication [bento-docs-33]. However, there is no explicit mention of SPF/DKIM/DMARC by name, no detail on a verification UI/status check flow, or troubleshooting for alignment issues. missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC record naming, verification/status confirmation flow, independent hands-on corroboration.
